title: A Vertical Channel-Enhanced Fusion Method Based on RINS and Barometric Altimeter for UAVs in GNSS Denial Environments
authors: X. Zhao; Y. Meng; F. Qi; L. Wang; X. Zhu
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Multi_Agent_Collaborative_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
